head: 50b8757c795d27df8537de3e1547389828915fa8
scope: Independent read-only source/consumer review with six bounded actual-compositor fixture controls; no source, Git, build, browser or terrain-generation mutation. Proposed association update remains Root-owned and requires generated readback.
derivation: Whole byte prefix and suffix match both donor and the prior admitted production pair. prefixSurface/integral/boxSurface/sampleField/joinLunarPixel and projectSurfaceCodes are unchanged. build_initial invokes unchanged MoonEngine.create/canonicalScene and the pinned WASM directly; it never calls startMoonDetail. The exact engine association remains 337e6a6980d0c54de436e768d0e007cb6d5e37a3fd98bbae46780e0ab1d0ea1c -> 05ec2e8b0eef0e5bc6b3c6556eb2f901b126c717f469b3c609a49b4edeaa8a32. No receiver derivation rerun is indicated.

finding.mechanism: Preview composes lunar detail before publishing real-sky-preview-ready. The previous detail gate refused and cleared that first staged join; preview then hid the SVG fallback and retired the baked head. NativeForegroundCapture deliberately excludes the lunar fallback when detail is enabled. This is a concrete missing-Moon publication mechanism; the exact r19 recording correlation remains Root-owned evidence.
finding.correction: Use the actual preview frame.current() authority instead of the future ready class; retain the final currentness check before lunar upload. The preview host retains its prewrite and final publication-headroom checks and only then publishes its ready class.
finding.independentControls: Old donor and exact r11 each publish zero for the valid staged preview; successor publishes once before either ready class. Successor staged/settled output hashes equal. Rejection at entry or pre-upload publishes zero and hides detail. All six controls passed; no visual/timing qualification inferred.
finding.remainingLimits: The test transports DOM/canvas in a fixture; actual publication/continuity and S1 remain to be checked against native originals. No claim that every Moon gap or the complete r19 gap has this sole cause.

requiredGuard: Keep initial-manifest.json f1184150163bb992279fe7a4f031917cd71d8558b2951b1997bf8dd67a3705f5 unchanged. Extend only the exact reviewed detail triple, retain engine pair and every asset/kernel/source check, pin the new association digest and retain the intentional r12 source-drift failure. Missing/unknown/tampered pairs must still fail. This finding does not waive the manifest or allow arbitrary future source changes.
qualification: No S1/S3/S7, cost, currentness lifecycle, merge, deployment or closure credit. Original 80ms/250ms predicates and all contrary captures remain.
